summary: Completed testing of Kynetik car community app focusing on 3D car viewer, 3D avatar viewer, and core functionality. Backend APIs are fully functional (100% success rate). Frontend authentication and landing page working correctly. 3D viewers partially working - some GLB models load successfully but Ferrari model has DRACO compression issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Ferrari 458 GLB model fails to load due to missing DRACOLoader configuration

integration_issues.issue: DRACO compressed models (Ferrari) fail to load while non-DRACO models (Concept Car) load successfully

Landing Page - Kynetik branding correct and visible
Authentication Flow - Google OAuth redirect working

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix DRACO loader configuration in Car3DViewer component. The Ferrari 458 model requires DRACO compression support but DRACOLoader is not properly initialized. Update the GLTFLoader setup to include DRACOLoader for models that need it (config.draco: true). Also verify that all GLB model URLs are accessible and working.
